svg.title: Factories, custom checks and callback registration
svg.desc: Check setup moves into beforePPCallbacks(), after BeginSourceFile and before clangd captures callbacks for preamble replay. The registry here is ClangTidyModuleRegistry (check factories), not FeatureModuleRegistry. Custom-check registration, its mutex, fast-check filtering and PP/matcher registration are retained. Check factories still come from ClangTidyModuleRegistry, not FeatureModuleRegistry. Custom-check registration, synchronization, fast filtering and callback registration are retained.
